style.summary: Flo floats white cards on a blush #F7EFED home and lavender #E2CBFF store backdrops, with feather pink #FF5A7D for period data and the Log period pill. Insight cards pair a lavender or pink top with a white bottom inside a 3 pt pink outline. Flat illustrations and round symptom icons carry the imagery, and only the sleep screen turns dark plum.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: About 22 pt side margins; a 7-day strip at a 51 pt pitch and a centered countdown top the home, then 2-column cards.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Insight cards: about 15 pt corners, 3 pt pink outlines; calendar bands: 8.3 pt corners; Log period: a 39 pt pill.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: Lavender #E2CBFF backdrops, white #FFFFFF cards, feather pink #FF5A7D for period days, outlines and the pill; teal #1DA4A7 marks ovulation.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: A flared high-contrast face sets store key words; SF Pro sets the app, Bold 49 pt for the countdown, Semibold for titles.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Flat illustrated people and hands appear on 3 of 8 shots; symptoms use round emoji-style icons in colored rings.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: A 7-day cycle strip with a 50 pt today circle, 2-color insight cards, and a month calendar with 41 pt period bands.

Headline “Got symptoms? Get answers” above the Symptom Checker: PCOS a significant match, then endometriosis, uterine fibroids and perimenopause as low matches

ourRead: 3 goals get their own product name: Ovulation & Health tracker ($11.49, $14.99), Birth Control Reminder ($43.99), Pregnancy Tracker ($49.99). The receipt repeats why you came.
The first screenshot wears a green “FSA/HSA eligible” sticker, U.S. only. It turns Premium, up to $59.99, into a health expense paid with pre-tax money.
All 8 screenshots sell features, from period predictions to pregnancy. Prices, $1.99 to $59.99, show only in the In-App Purchases list. Value first, price later.

improvements.title: Add the length to all 10 names
improvements.detail: 6 listings share the name Flo Premium, from $1.99 to $59.99. Keep the goal names and add the term to each, like “Flo Premium, 1 year”.
improvements.rule: Fix 3 things to stop a design from looking cheap: low contrast, a broken layout, and copy that does not convert.

improvements.title: Darken the button pink to 4.6:1
improvements.detail: White “Log period” on #FF5A7D reads at 3.0:1. Fill the pill with #D9345E, the same hue, for 4.6:1, and keep #FF5A7D for the icon and period days.
improvements.rule: Text contrast: at least 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for text 24 px and larger.

improvements.title: Keep pink for period days and the button
improvements.detail: Screen 1 puts pink on 5 predicted days, the Log period pill and 2 card outlines. Drop the 3 px outlines from all 6 insight cards on screens 1, 2 and 4.
improvements.rule: One accent per screen. Directing attention means one place to look.

stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Flo's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% lavender #E2CBFF: onboarding and hero backdrops; home screens fade blush #F7EFED to #FDFCFA.
- 30% white #FFFFFF: cards, lists and sheets.
- 10% feather pink #FF5A7D: period days, card outlines and the main pill; teal #1DA4A7 marks ovulation.
Type:
- Headlines: Philosopher 400 for key words in a pale pink box, 10 pt corners, under a Medium sans line.
- Body: Inter 600, close to SF Pro, 17 to 20 pt titles; Inter 400 for grey details, 700 for big numbers.
Shapes:
- Cards 15 pt corners; buttons are full pills.
Layout:
- About 22 pt side margins; week strip and countdown on top, cards in 2 columns.
Components:
- Week strip: 7 columns, 51 pt pitch; today in a 50 pt white circle, predicted days in dotted pink rings.
- Insight card: lavender or pink top half, white bottom with icon and value, 3 pt pink outline.
- Log button: 39 pt pink pill, white Inter 600 label.
Icons and imagery:
- Flat illustrated people; round symptom icons in colored rings.
Check:
- Pink marks only period data and the main action.
- Cards are white on lavender or blush.
- Headline key words sit in a pale pink box.
